source_name: SAM.gov — Contract Opportunities (US government, country=Kosovo)
why_relevant: Authoritative and machine-readable registry of all US federal solicitations and awards, including USAID/Kosovo and MCC-related contracting. The only reliable structured channel for US-funded procurement now that USAID country web presences are unstable.

source_name: MCC / Federal Register — Kosovo Compact notices
why_relevant: Authoritative legal record of the MCC–Kosovo Compact (signed 15 July 2022, USD 202m MCC + USD 34.67m government contribution) that frames all MFK procurement. Federal Register is a stable, structured, API-accessible archive for compact amendments and closure notices.

source_name: EIB Group Supplier Portal / EIB Procurement
why_relevant: Covers EIB's own corporate and advisory calls for tender under EU procurement rules. EIB lending into Kosovo financial intermediaries generally produces no public tender, so this is a lower-yield but necessary completeness source for the IFI set.

source_name: World Bank Group eProcure / RFxNow (WBG corporate & advisory advertisements)
why_relevant: Where WBG corporate and IFC advisory-services procurement is advertised — including IFC digital financial services / fintech / embedded-finance advisory assignments that name Kosovo alongside Albania, Bosnia and Georgia. IFC advisory work is a leading indicator of digital-payments market activity that produces no borrower-side tender.

source_name: dgMarket — donor tender aggregator
why_relevant: Long-running commercial aggregator of donor and government tender notices; explicitly named in MFK/MCC notices as a mandated publication channel alongside UNDB. Now materially more important because UNDB ceased operation in 2025, leaving dgMarket as one of the few cross-donor archives.

source_name: Kosovo.energy — republisher of MCC/MFK Specific Procurement Notices in Albanian
why_relevant: Sector news site that reproduces MFK 'Njoftim Specifik për Prokurim (NSP)' notices in Albanian alongside the English SPN. Useful as a bilingual terminology anchor and as a mirror when MFK rotates notices off its site.

source_name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily (EU Official Journal S-series)
why_relevant: Single authoritative publication venue for EU-managed (IPA/EEAS/DG NEAR) contract notices and contract award notices covering Kosovo, including financial-sector TA, banking supervision, and payment-system contracts. Award notices name winning supplier, consortium and contract value.

source_name: TED Developer Documentation / eForms schema & bulk data
why_relevant: Defines the machine-readable structure of every TED notice (eForms), the search API, and bulk XML packages — the technical key to automating award-notice harvesting for Kosovo financial-sector contracts.

source_name: EU Funding & Tenders Portal (SEDIA) — calls for tenders and calls for proposals
why_relevant: Central entry point for Commission-managed procurement and grants, including IPA III actions where Kosovo is an eligible beneficiary; carries tender documents, annexes and (for some) results. Complements TED with fuller documentation packages.

source_name: DG ENEST — Kosovo: financial assistance under IPA
why_relevant: Country page listing IPA financing decisions, annual action documents and sector allocations for Kosovo — the upstream signal that tells you which financial-sector/PFM/digital contracts will be tendered 6-18 months later.

source_name: DG ENEST — Funding recipients / Aid transparency (IATI, beneficiaries search)
why_relevant: Publishes contract-level beneficiary data for enlargement funding, including contracts signed under indirect management by partner countries — the way to see who actually got paid on Kosovo IPA financial-sector actions.

source_name: European Commission Financial Transparency System (FTS)
why_relevant: Searchable database of EU budget beneficiaries under direct and indirect management; useful to identify vendors paid on Kosovo-related enlargement lines even when the TED award notice is thin. Caveat found in EC guidance: IPA is partly managed nationally, so FTS coverage of Kosovo contracts is incomplete.

source_name: EEAS — Tenders (central EEAS tender listing)
why_relevant: Aggregates delegation-level calls for tender and prior information notices, including those of the EU Office in Kosovo; low-value contracts here never reach TED, so this is the only public trace of them.

source_name: EEAS — EU Projects with Kosovo
why_relevant: Delegation-curated inventory of running EU-funded projects in Kosovo; each entry names the implementing contractor/consortium, budget and sector — a bridge from award notice to who is actually delivering financial-sector and digitalisation work.

source_name: WeBalkans.eu — EU funding opportunities and projects in Kosovo
why_relevant: EU-run communication platform aggregating IPA III, EU4 programmes, Digital Europe and Horizon participation for the Western Balkans; a fast index of programme names and acronyms to feed back into TED/F&T searches.

source_name: EU4Digital Facility (regional programme incl. Kosovo)
why_relevant: Regional EU4-branded facility covering digital economy/e-payments topics where Kosovo is a listed beneficiary; its phases are tendered as large multi-country service contracts, so award notices reveal the incumbent consortium for digital/payments advisory across the region.

source_name: EU Twinning instrument — Kosovo twinning fiches (DG ENEST / member-state NCP sites)
why_relevant: Twinning is a preferred IPA implementation modality in Kosovo, used for central-bank and public-finance institution building. Fiches (numbered e.g. KS/xx/IPA/...) state the beneficiary institution, budget and mandated results before any procurement — earliest reliable signal of an incoming financial-supervision project.

source_name: IPA project fiches archive (DG ENEST document download service)
why_relevant: Historic and current Kosovo IPA project fiches (e.g. public finance) give the full intervention logic, indicative contract split (service/supply/twinning) and budgets — directly predictive of tender structure.

source_name: FWC SEA 2023 — Framework Contract Services for the EU's External Action (successor to FWC SIEA 2018)
source_subtype: framework contract / consortium disclosure by lot holder
why_relevant: Most short/medium EU technical assistance in Kosovo (including financial sector, PFM and digital payments advisory) is contracted through FWC lots rather than open tenders, so the framework lot holders are the de-facto pre-selected supplier pool. Lot 8 (Sustainable Finance) and the ICT/digital lots are the relevant cells.

source_name: Publications Office of the EU — public procurement (EU institutions' own tenders)
why_relevant: Hosts procurement detail pages for EU-institution and facility tenders, including Western Balkans Investment Framework technical-assistance packages that reach Kosovo; complements TED with full procurement detail records.

source_name: Western Balkans Investment Framework (WBIF) — grant and TA pipeline
why_relevant: EU-led blending facility (EC + EIB/EBRD/CEB) financing Kosovo projects including digital-economy infrastructure; its Infrastructure Project Facility TA packages are tendered EU-side and their outputs shape later national payment/digital procurements.

source_name: EIB — calls for technical assistance (WBIF/IPF series)
why_relevant: Publishes the TA calls the EIB runs on behalf of WBIF, several of which cover Kosovo and digital-economy scope; award information identifies the consultancy consortia active in the region.

source_name: DevelopmentAid — EU/IPA tender and award aggregator
why_relevant: Commercial aggregator that indexes EU external-action tenders (incl. multi-country ones naming Kosovo) with sector tagging such as Macro-Economy & Public Finance and ICT; useful for retrospective discovery of notices that are hard to re-find on TED.
